components.description: Gem, crystal, or reliquary worth 500+ GP
components.note: Not consumed on casting; the receptacle is destroyed when the spell ends.

compendium.summary: Possession engine with severe body, range and death risks.
warnings: The Compendium index is an operating reference, not replacement spell text. Confirm the active D&D Beyond entry before casting.
Component planning: Needed for body-theft tech. Also needs a table agreement and a safe container plan.
Pre-cast gate: Secure the original body and container; define distance, possession, and ending states.
Failure state: Container destruction, body death, forced return failure, or hostile control of the site.
Safe operating default: Use a guarded site, explicit abort conditions, and a recovery team. See Chapter 22.
